steps.title: 打开根目录菜单 / Open the root menu
填写一级目录名称 / Enter the first-level folder name
填写二级目录名称 / Enter the second-level folder name
填写三级目录名称 / Enter the third-level folder name
三级目录不能继续新建子目录 / A third-level folder cannot add a subfolder
无命中时打开规则菜单 / Open the Rule menu before any hits
在列表中填写规则名称 / Enter the Rule name inline
invalid状态必须在Statusbar和Apply边界一致，不能把未填写字段写入Core。 / Invalid state must agree across Statusbar and Apply, never writing missing fields to Core.
补齐Host条件 / Complete the Host condition
补齐Header名称 / Complete the Header name
补齐Header值 / Complete the Header value
填完默认host/header字段并启用rule，Statusbar转dirty且Apply恢复。 / Complete the default host/header fields and enable the Rule; Statusbar becomes dirty and Apply recovers.
选中目录时保留正在编辑的规则 / Keep the open Rule editor when selecting a folder
选择目录只改树落点，右侧仍打开同一rule；随后Apply并验证revision。 / Folder selection changes only the tree target; the same Rule stays open before Apply and revision verification.
匹配请求使规则命中数变为1 / A matching request raises the Rule hit count to 1
命中后打开Show matching requests / Open Show matching requests after a hit
在Capture选择本次GET /e2e/rules/hierarchy-status / Select this GET /e2e/rules/hierarchy-status request in Capture
Capture中查看初始规则写入的Header和来源 / Inspect the initial Rule Header and its source in Capture
点击Header来源标记返回同一规则 / Follow the Header source marker back to the same Rule
填写method条件的第1个值 / Enter value 1 for the method condition
填写path条件的第1个值 / Enter value 1 for the path condition
填写url条件的第1个值 / Enter value 1 for the url condition
填写query条件的第2个值 / Enter value 2 for the query condition
填写header条件的第2个值 / Enter value 2 for the header condition
填写status条件的第2个值 / Enter value 2 for the status condition
填写mime条件的第1个值 / Enter value 1 for the mime condition
响应条件使用响应阶段Header动作 / Use a response-phase Header action with response conditions
保存八类AND条件 / Save all eight AND conditions
查看GET /e2e/rules/all-conditions?case=and的response Header结果 / Inspect response Header results for GET /e2e/rules/all-conditions?case=and
查看POST /e2e/rules/all-conditions?case=and的response Header结果 / Inspect response Header results for POST /e2e/rules/all-conditions?case=and
填写用于比较匹配模式的Path / Enter the Path for comparing matching modes
查看GET /e2e/rules/modes/case/extra的response Header结果 / Inspect response Header results for GET /e2e/rules/modes/case/extra
开启Aa大小写敏感 / Enable Aa case sensitivity
查看GET /e2e/rules/modes/case/extra的response Header结果 / Inspect response Header results for GET /e2e/rules/modes/case/extra
选择精确匹配 / Select exact matching
查看GET /e2e/rules/modes/Case/extra的response Header结果 / Inspect response Header results for GET /e2e/rules/modes/Case/extra
查看GET /e2e/rules/modes/Case的response Header结果 / Inspect response Header results for GET /e2e/rules/modes/Case
填写无效正则示例 / Enter the invalid regex example
查看GET /e2e/rules/modes/Case的response Header结果 / Inspect response Header results for GET /e2e/rules/modes/Case
填写数字路径正则 / Enter the numeric-path regex
查看GET /e2e/rules/modes/Case/123的response Header结果 / Inspect response Header results for GET /e2e/rules/modes/Case/123
查看GET /e2e/rules/modes/Case/letters的response Header结果 / Inspect response Header results for GET /e2e/rules/modes/Case/letters
填写响应MIME通配符 / Enter the response MIME wildcard
查看GET /e2e/rules/modes/Case/124的response Header结果 / Inspect response Header results for GET /e2e/rules/modes/Case/124
查看GET /e2e/rules/modes/Case/125的response Header结果 / Inspect response Header results for GET /e2e/rules/modes/Case/125
配置嵌套规则的优先级示例 / Configure the nested Rule for the priority example
填写根规则名称 / Enter the root Rule name
填写根规则Path / Enter the root Rule Path
填写根规则Header值 / Enter the root Rule Header value
启用根规则，准备保存顺序 / Enable the root Rule before saving the order
查看GET /e2e/rules/priority/before-drag的request Header结果 / Inspect request Header results for GET /e2e/rules/priority/before-drag
拖拽前的已保存规则顺序 / The saved Rule order before dragging
将根规则拖到嵌套规则之前 / Drag the root Rule before the nested Rule
查看GET /e2e/rules/priority/after-drag的request Header结果 / Inspect request Header results for GET /e2e/rules/priority/after-drag
调整规则顺序后核对真实Header覆盖 / Verify actual Header precedence after reordering Rules
按名称搜索根规则 / Search for the root Rule by name
填写目录的新名称 / Enter the new folder name
折叠目录隐藏子规则 / Collapse the folder to hide its child Rules
打开非最后一条规则的删除菜单 / Open Delete for a Rule that is not the last one
删除竞争规则后仍保留嵌套规则 / Keep the nested Rule after deleting the competing Rule
将保留规则移回根目录 / Move the retained Rule back to the root
打开空目录的删除菜单 / Open Delete for the empty folder
查看GET /e2e/rules/priority/after-deletion的request Header结果 / Inspect request Header results for GET /e2e/rules/priority/after-deletion
删除非最后规则和空目录后保留有效规则 / Keep the valid Rule after deleting a non-last Rule and empty folders
